## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code quality / Refactoring

## Code & Security Checklist

- [ ] My code compiles cleanly without errors (`npx tsc --noEmit` checks out)
- [ ] All functions are 50 lines or fewer
- [ ] User-supplied text is sanitized before insertion into the database
- [ ] No secrets, keys, database strings, or personal emails are committed or logged in plaintext
- [ ] Only standard logging utility (`logger`) is used instead of `console.*`
- [ ] Terminology guidelines followed (no "tip" / "tipping" used; referred to as **Value-for-Value / V4V** or **Direct Support**)
